sentences.text: I love being a couch potato every once in a while.
sentences.text_ko: 가끔은 소파에 누워 아무것도 안 하는 게 너무 좋아.

sentences.text: Just a day to fully relax and recharge.
It's so nice to skip the chores, forget the to -do list, and just take it easy sometimes.
sentences.text_ko: 집안일도 미루고 할 일 목록도 잊고 그냥 느긋하게 쉬는 게 참 좋아.

sentences.text: On my lazy days, I let myself sleep in and I don't even bother getting dressed.
sentences.text_ko: 이런 날엔 늦잠 자고 옷 갈아입을 생각도 안 해.

sentences.text: I just stay in my sweats all day.
I start the day by treating myself to an iced latte while scrolling on my phone or reading in bed.
sentences.text_ko: 침대에서 폰 보거나 책 읽으면서 아이스 라테로 하루를 시작해.

sentences.text: If I get hungry in the afternoon, I order something because cooking takes too much effort.
sentences.text_ko: 오후에 배고프면 요리하기 귀찮아서 그냥 시켜 먹어.

sentences.text: I usually just order whatever I'm craving at the moment.
Once the food arrives, it's time to curl up on the couch and binge watch a show.
sentences.text_ko: 음식 오면 소파에 파묻혀서 몰아보기 시작이지.

sentences.text: I've been really into reality shows lately.
They're so easy to get hooked on.
While watching, I snack on my favorite junk food like popcorn, chips, candy, or ice cream.
sentences.text_ko: 보면서 팝콘, 과자, 사탕, 아이스크림 같은 간식도 먹고.

sentences.text: Since the whole day is about being comfortable, I might light a candle to make my apartment feel extra cozy.
sentences.text_ko: 편안함이 전부인 날이라 촛불 하나 켜두면 집이 더 아늑해져.

sentences.text: To end the day, I do a bit of self -care.
I like taking a hot shower or putting on a face mask before crawling into bed.
sentences.text_ko: 자기 전에 뜨거운 샤워하거나 팩 하나 붙여.

sentences.text: Lazy days like this are rare, but they're so good for the soul.
sentences.text_ko: 이런 늘어지는 날은 자주는 아니지만, 마음엔 진짜 좋아.

full_transcript: Day 7. Lazy Day. I love being a couch potato every once in a while. No alarms, no plans. Just a day to fully relax and recharge. It's so nice to skip the chores, forget the to-do list, and just take it easy sometimes. On my lazy days, I let myself sleep in and I don't even bother getting dressed. I just stay in my sweats all day. I start the day by treating myself to an iced latte while scrolling on my phone or reading in bed. If I get hungry in the afternoon, I order something because cooking takes too much effort. I usually just order whatever I'm craving at the moment. Once the food arrives, it's time to curl up on the couch and binge watch a show. I've been really into reality shows lately. They're so easy to get hooked on. While watching, I snack on my favorite junk food like popcorn, chips, candy, or ice cream. Since the whole day is about being comfortable, I might light a candle to make my apartment feel extra cozy. To end the day, I do a bit of self-care. I like taking a hot shower or putting on a face mask before crawling into bed. Lazy days like this are rare, but they're so good for the soul.
